match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett checks the time, grabs her sunglasses, and sweeps out of frame. Framing: medium, eye level, Scarlett's reflection is centered in the bathroom mirror, with the coral lipstick vivid against the neutral tiles and her phone and sunglasses low in frame. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett faces the mirror with lipstick freshly applied, paused in a small smile while holding the lipstick near her face. Camera, as one or two arrows: static, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
